command: cd <path> && git log --oneline -5 && echo "---HEAD---" && git show HEAD --stat
cd <path> && git diff HEAD^ HEAD && echo "===FILES===" && ls -la && echo "===TREE===" && find . -type f -not -path './.git/*'
cd <path> && echo "--- target.py (HEAD) ---" && nl -ba src/target.py && echo "--- caller.py ---" && nl -ba src/caller.py && echo "--- base target.py ---" && git show HEAD^:src/target.py | nl -ba
